high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of a social media post from the account "@EndWokeness," which appears to be discussing a policy change by the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA). The post includes a statement at the top that reads: "I still get at least one message a month with a gay pride flag adorning a hallway in a VA building somewhere, but this iconic picture is off limits." Below this statement, there is an "EXCLUSIVE" label followed by a news headline: "The Department Of Veterans Affairs just BANNED the V-J Day kiss photo from all department facilities.
